title: Hidden instruction can be stored in the shared answer cache
description: A question followed by an instruction in Unicode tag characters has the same cache key as the plain question, so if the model follows the hidden instruction its answer is served to later visitors who ask the plain question.
claimed_root_cause: normalizeQuestion keeps only letters and digits, while the model receives the full text including tag characters.

trace.description: The visitor controls the full question text.
Tag characters are dropped from the cache key.
The model answer is stored under the plain question key for later visitors.

evidence.description: Single-turn questions without PII are cached.

blockers: Whether the configured models obey instructions encoded in Unicode tag characters cannot be decided from source.

validation_plan.local: With a test bot and a test model key, ask the plain question plus a tag-encoded instruction to add a marker word, then ask the plain question from a second session and check for the marker.

title: Invisible Unicode characters bypass the prompt-injection guard
description: A public visitor can hide injection phrasing or a prompt tag from detectInjection by inserting zero-width, soft-hyphen, word-joiner or Unicode tag characters; the text then reaches the model unchanged.
root_cause: detectInjection normalises with NFKC only and no code path removes Unicode format characters before the guard or the model.
intended_behavior: Questions and history turns matching the injection patterns get the fixed guard reply and never reach the model.

trace.description: The question is read from the body and only trimmed.
detectInjection decides whether the question reaches the model.
The question is placed raw inside <question> in the model prompt.

evidence.description: detectInjection applies NFKC and regexes; Cf characters survive and break every pattern.

execution.attacker_perspective: Any anonymous visitor of a bot.
instructions: Send the payload as the question through the public chat API.
execution.observed_result: detectInjection returns false for the payloads and true for the same text without the invisible characters.

remediation.strategy: Strip Unicode format characters and variation selectors before detection and wherever a question or history turn enters the pipeline.

likelihood.reason: One request with a copy-pasted payload.

impact.reason: The model still only sees this bot's public excerpts and answers only the attacker.

confidence.reason: Reproduced locally against the source function by two independent agents.

title: TSbot bot may accept chat from any website
description: If bot 7stk3pruaq has an empty allowed-origins list, any site can embed it and spend its daily quota from visitors' browsers.
claimed_root_cause: The public API middleware allows every Origin when the per-bot list and ALLOWED_ORIGINS are empty.

trace.description: The middleware compares Origin with the allowlist.

evidence.description: ok is true when the allowlist is empty.

blockers: The bot's allowedOrigins setting lives in D1, not in the repository.

validation_plan.local: In the Nara dashboard, open bot 7stk3pruaq, Pasang widget, and read the allowed origins list.

title: Closing </follow_up> escapes the rewrite prompt
description: The rewrite prompt wraps the question in <follow_up> and the guard did not list that tag.
claimed_root_cause: The INJECTION tag pattern omitted follow_up.

evidence.description: The rewritten text is only used as this bot's retrieval query.

reason: The rewrite result is never shown or cached and only searches the same bot's documents, which the visitor can already search by asking; no boundary is crossed. The tag was added to the guard anyway.

title: innerHTML sinks in the widget (Semgrep insecure-innerhtml)
description: Semgrep flagged six innerHTML assignments in public/widget.js.
claimed_root_cause: Server or model strings could reach innerHTML.

trace.description: Rendered answer HTML is assigned to innerHTML.

evidence.description: inline() escapes the whole text before formatting; numbers go through Number().

reason: Every dynamic value is escaped, numeric, or set with textContent; a browser harness with hostile answers, sources, suggestions and colour produced no element.
